description: The Zenodo record publishes a 31.5 kB XLSX workbook and an HTML analysis for rainfall regime research in Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa and Zimbabwe. Its description identifies station name, country, agro-ecological zone, year, recorded rainfall and coordinates. Zenodo shows CC BY 4.0 and a public file listing without a fee. The describing article, however, says the supporting meteorological-service data are available only on request under service restrictions. The public workbook's completeness and rights relative to those underlying station series could not be checked without opening the file, which this review does not do. It may support drought, irrigation and food-production scenario analysis, but users must verify years, sampling and redistribution rights before reusing station values. This is tabular station history, not a spatially complete climate grid. It complements data-era5-reanalysis with local observations where permitted.
